description: This file defines a QWidget subclass for real-time waveform plotting of audio data, including methods for loading WAV files, plotting waveforms centered on a current time, and handling user interface events.

classes.name: Plot_waveform_RT
classes.description: A QWidget subclass for real-time waveform visualization of audio data, with methods for loading WAV files, plotting waveforms, and event handling.

methods.name: eventFilter
methods.description: Intercepts key press events and emits a signal to the main window.

methods.name: get_wav_info
methods.description: Reads a WAV file and extracts the audio signal and frame rate.

methods.name: load_wav
methods.description: Loads a WAV file and stores its information for plotting.

methods.name: time_interval_changed
methods.description: Adjusts the time interval for waveform display.

methods.name: plot_waveform
methods.description: Plots the waveform centered on a specified current time, handling edge cases for start and end of media.
